source_document.title: Trained Leader Requirements - Unit and Other Positions

sources.citation: Scouting America, Trained Leader Requirements - Unit and Other Positions

notes: Shows both halves of the model. `requires` entries are ALL required - Youth Protection plus position-specific training - while alternatives live inside an entry as `choose`. Here the choice is classroom C40 or the online path, and the online course carries its three modules. The key is (position, unit_type): registration code CM is a Cubmaster only in a pack, and code CC would need a completely different course in each of the five unit types.
